 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 11-01-2024 1.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned APP for the State.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the quashing application with respect to petitioner no.2, who died during pendency of the present quashing application.

4. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 by both modes i.e. speed post as well as ordinary post with A/D, for which necessary requisites must be filed on or before 19.01.2024, failing which the quashing application shall stand Patna High Court CR.
